description: This file implements the Telemetry plugin for a WPEFramework-based system, including initialization, event handling, and communication with other system components via RPC, IARM, and RBUS. It defines methods for report management, privacy mode notification, and event logging.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: Main class implementing the Telemetry plugin, handling initialization, event subscription, report management, and privacy mode notifications.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on the provided parameters, updating RFC parameters accordingly.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value, sending it via telemetry.

methods.name: uploadReport
methods.description: Triggers the upload of a telemetry report via RBUS.

methods.name: abortReport
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing telemetry report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies the system of a change in privacy mode via RBUS.

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles the status update of report upload, sending a notification.
